name: promptlibrary-kit
description: Project-local prompt library: keep reusable prompts (written by you, Claude or Codex, extracted from a session, or imported from the web) in a validated catalog, verify and optimize each one before it can be used, look prompts up read-only, and run one or more verified prompts in Claude after a full-text preview and a single approval. Python standard library only; no hooks, MCP server or background process.
